labels.note: max=0 makes math.log(0) raise ValueError; original returned a clamped 0 wait.
exp_base=1 makes math.log(x,1) raise ZeroDivisionError instead of returning a constant multiplier wait.
At equality, result equals max mathematically; both paths return max(min, max) apart from float rounding.
With max=inf and many attempts, overflow returns None, so sleep fails; uncommon config.
Only changes a forward-reference string in a type alias; no runtime effect.
Guard is a shortcut; results differ only on overflow with min>max, a misconfiguration.
Forces a 1s floor: small multiplier/jitter or max<1 now return wrong, longer waits.
